name: Geppaku: Monogatari
source: "Congratulations, if you're reading this, you're oficially nominated, present yourself in the City of spirits's three houses to keep up" Third and last entry in the "Time traveler" trilogy, created by Commodorette. Mediums, the ones born with a psychic skill superior to those of the ordinary population, they're few, hidden among ordinary people, why? Only they know that. It's common knowledge that these people are the target of this world's protective deities, who search and choose them as helpers, if they're chosen, they'll live in servitude and with the honors of the deity who called them. Homever, from the summoning to being oficially a "Medium", there's an inmense gap, so the term "Nominated" is also used for them. Mizuno Mai, 16, receives a letter informing her that she's been nominated to become a medium, despite not being interested in the offer, she decides to go to the adress anyways.
translation: “恭喜你，如果你正在读这篇文章，你就被正式提名，在精神之城的三座房子里展示自己，以跟上” 由Commodorette创作的“时间旅行者”三部曲的第三部也是最后一部。通灵者，天生神通高于常人的人，数量很少，隐藏在常人之中，为什么？只有他们自己知道。众所周知，这些人是这个世界的保护神灵的目标，他们寻找并选择他们作为帮助者，如果他们被选择，他们将生活在奴役中，并享有召唤他们的神灵的荣耀。荷马从被召唤到正式成为“媒介”，有着巨大的差距，所以也用“提名”这个词来称呼他们。16岁的水野麻衣收到一封信，通知她已被提名成为一名灵媒，尽管她对此不感兴趣，但还是决定前往该地址。
